meta.instructions: This is a weekly repeating athletic training schedule. Use this JSON to: (1) generate Google Apps Script code that creates all events as recurring weekly events in Google Calendar, OR (2) generate an .ics file the user can import directly. Each event has a recurrence rule (RRULE) for weekly repeat. Replace START_DATE with the user's next upcoming Monday in YYYY-MM-DD format. All times are local — ask the user for their timezone if unknown. Group events by calendarName to create separate Google Calendars for each category.
meta.weekStructure: Mon=HPT1, Tue=Skill1, Wed=HPT2, Thu=Recovery, Fri=HPT3+Dunk, Sat=Skill2, Sun=HPT4

06:30 Wake — no snooze. 16 oz water + electrolytes
06:35 5–10 min morning sunlight outside
06:45 10 min mobility flow — hips, ankles, thoracic
06:55 Pre-training fuel
07:00 Mental prep — review today's training goals

90-MIN HIGH PERFORMANCE TRAINING

[1] Movement Prep (10 min)
Hip circles, ankle circles, leg swings 2x10 each
High knees + butt kicks 2x20m
Lateral shuffle + carioca 2x10m
Glute bridge activation 2x15

[2] Mobility (10 min)
Ankle wall drill 3x10 each
Banded ankle distraction 2x30 sec
90/90 hip stretch 2x45 sec each side
Hip flexor lunge stretch 2x45 sec each side

[3] Jump Development (15 min)
Pogo Jumps 3x20-25 — stiff ankles, rapid contact
Depth Drops 3x5-8 off 12-15in box — land soft
Broad Jumps 3x5 max effort — arm swing, stick landing

[4] Strength (30 min)
Trap Bar Deadlift — phase-dependent sets/reps
Slant Board Squat — 15-25deg board, full depth
Single-Leg RDL 3x8-10 each leg
Copenhagen Plank 3x20-35 sec
Slant Board Isometric 5x45 sec at 70-90deg — LAST exercise

[5] Athletic Development (12 min)
Acceleration Runs 5x20m — focus first 3 steps
Pro Agility 5-10-5 — 4x each direction
Lateral Defensive Slides 3x10m

[6] Basketball Transfer (8 min)
Approach jump to rim 10x max reach
Jump stop + explode 5x game speed

[7] Recovery Protocol (10 min)
Tibialis Raises 3x20
Soleus Raises 3x15 bent knee
Foot strength towel scrunches 2x30 sec
Foam roll calves/quads 60 sec each

JUMP SCIENCE FOCUS:
- Reactive Stiffness: pogo stiff ankles, shorten contact each week
- Penultimate Step: extend 2nd-to-last step 10-15%
- Arm Load: arms back behind hips, drive UP at takeoff

events.summary: Basketball Skill Day 1 — Ball Handling + Finishing
events.description:
75-MIN BASKETBALL SKILL SESSION

[1] Court Warm-Up (8 min)
Full-court jog + back-pedal 3 laps
Defensive slides baseline to baseline 4x
Dynamic layup series 5x each side

[2] Ball Handling (15 min)
Two-ball stationary dribbling 3x30 sec
Figure-8 low dribble 3x20 sec each direction
Full-court combo moves 5x — crossover, between-legs, behind-back
Chair drills attack + crossover + pullback x10

[3] Finishing (15 min)
Mikan drill both hands 3x10 each side
Euro-step layup 5x each side game speed
Floater running + pull-up 5x each side
Power layup / dunk approach 10x max effort

[4] Footwork (10 min)
Drop-step post move 5x each block
Step-back jumper 5x each wing
Transition run + finish 5x full court

[5] Conditioning (15 min)
Suicide sprints 4x — walk back rest
Defensive slide + sprint back 4x
Transition finishing drill 5x full court both ways

55-MIN SHOOTING & FINISHING SESSION

[1] Form Shooting — Foundation (10 min)
5 feet from rim: 10 makes — BEEF mechanics only
Free throw line: 10 makes
Right elbow: 7 makes. Left elbow: 7 makes
Elbow under ball, full goose-neck wrist snap every rep

[2] Spot Shooting — 5-Spot Foundation (15 min)
FT line 10 makes → Right elbow 7 → Left elbow 7
Right wing 3pt 5 makes → Left wing 3pt 5 makes
Miss 3 in a row? Move 2 feet closer, rebuild, come back

[3] Finishing Tier 1 — Essential (15 min)
Power layup 10x each side — jump THROUGH contact
Finger roll 3x10 each hand
Reverse layup 3x8 each side — use the backboard

[4] Competitive: Game of 21 (10 min)
7 spots x 3 shots = 21 total
Target: 14+/21 — record score every session
Hit 17+? Add 2 spots from 3-point range next session

Mid-Morning Meal — 480 kcal | P40 C55 F8
4 oz chicken breast
1 cup white rice (fast digesting)
1 cup steamed vegetables
1 tsp olive oil

Pre-Court Meal (2-3 hrs before) — 600 kcal | P50 C58 F12
6 oz turkey breast
1 cup cooked quinoa
Mixed greens + cherry tomatoes
Balsamic drizzle

Pre-Game Snack (30-60 min before court) — 180 kcal | P4 C32 F5
2 Medjool dates + 1 tbsp peanut butter
1/2 banana
16 oz water with electrolytes

Post-Court Recovery Dinner — 680 kcal | P52 C58 F22
8 oz grilled chicken thigh
1.5 cups roasted potatoes
2 cups asparagus + olive oil

Post-meal: 10-min walk

90-MIN HIGH PERFORMANCE TRAINING

[1] Movement Prep (10 min)
Dynamic warm-up: high knees, butt kicks, A-skip, B-skip
Hip activation band work: clamshells, monster walks 2x15
Ankle circles + calf raises 2x15

[2] Mobility (8 min)
World greatest stretch 5 each side
Ankle mobility seated band distraction 2x30 sec
Pigeon pose 60 sec each side

[3] Jump Development (20 min)
Band Assisted Jumps 4x8-12 — approach jumps, dunk attempts
Pogo Jumps → Single-Leg Pogos 3x20 bilateral + 3x12 each leg
Reactive lateral bounds 4x5 each leg — land and explode
Vertical jump max efforts 5x measured — RECORD IN DUNK LAB

[4] Speed Development (20 min)
First step explosion 6x10m standing start
Flying 20m sprints 4x rolling start
T-drill change of direction 4x each way
Deceleration → reacceleration 5x 10m stop/start

[5] Strength Supplemental (15 min)
Slant Board Squat 2x8 maintenance volume
Tibialis Raises 3x20
Soleus Raises 3x15
Foot strength scrunches 2x30 sec

[6+7] Transfer + Recovery (15 min)
Dunk approach footwork 1-step, 2-step, 3-step x5 each
Foam roll full lower body 60 sec per zone
Hip flexor stretch 60 sec each side

JUMP SCIENCE FOCUS:
- Arm Swing Activation: wall arm swing 3x20 BEFORE approach jumps
- Reactive Bounds: <0.3 sec contact, arms cross and UP each bound
- Film 3 approach jumps from the side — check arm peak timing

Recovery Day — Later, easier start
07:00 Wake — no alarm pressure. 16 oz water + electrolytes
07:05 Morning sun walk (barefoot if possible)
07:15 Full-body mobility flow 20 min
07:40 Slant board mobility only — NOT strength — 2x10 controlled no load
07:50 Foot massage lacrosse ball 3 min each foot

90-MIN ACTIVE RECOVERY

Morning Flow (30 min)
- Morning sun walk 10 min
- Full-body mobility flow 20 min — hip, ankle, thoracic
- Slant board mobility (NOT strength) 2x10
- Foot massage lacrosse ball 3 min each foot

Tissue Work (20 min)
- Foam roll: calves, quads, IT band, glutes — 90 sec each
- Hip flexor trigger point lacrosse ball 2 min each side
- Thoracic extension over roller 2 min
- Tibialis raises light 1x15 maintenance only

Zone 2 Walk (25-35 min)
- Easy walking pace — able to hold a full conversation
- Target 8,000-10,000 total steps today
- Post-dinner walk 10 min after dinner (every day)

Evening Recovery
- Light yoga or hip stretching 15 min yin style
- Contrast shower: 3 min hot / 1 min cold x3 rounds
- Recovery stack: magnesium + omega-3 + tart cherry
- Epsom salt bath (weekly, optional)

MAIN WEEKLY SHOP — 60-90 min
Stores: Walmart/ALDI (primary) + Costco on monthly bulk run

Checklist:
- Proteins: chicken breast, salmon, eggs, turkey, cottage cheese, Greek yogurt
- Produce: bananas, berries, greens, broccoli, sweet potato, avocado, lemons
- Carbs: oats, brown rice, quinoa, Ezekiel bread, potatoes
- Pantry: olive oil, nuts, honey, peanut butter (restock only when low)
- Hydration: electrolytes, tart cherry juice, orange juice

Budget target: $100-140/week

Anti-Inflammatory Lunch — 560 kcal | P48 C48 F18
6 oz wild salmon
1 cup cooked lentils
2 cups spinach salad
Olive oil + apple cider vinegar dressing + lemon

Recovery Snack — 220 kcal | P5 C36 F12
1 oz mixed nuts
1 apple
4 oz tart cherry juice — reduces DOMS significantly

Repair Dinner — 680 kcal | P52 C52 F20
7 oz chicken breast
1 cup sweet potato
2 cups broccoli with garlic + olive oil
Side salad

Post-meal: 10-min walk

120-MIN HPT 3 + WEEKLY DUNK SESSION

[1] CNS Warm-Up (12 min)
Mini trampoline OR pogo jumps 5 min — prime elastic system
Ankle + hip mobility fast circuit 7 min
Ankle alphabet + calf raises 1x15

[2] DUNK SESSION — WEEKLY (25 min)
Standing reach measurement 3 attempts — RECORD
Max jump reach measurement 3 attempts — RECORD
1/2/3-step approach work 5x each — master footwork
Band assisted dunks current + next stage 5x5
Max dunk attempts current stage 10-15 reps — rest 90 sec each
Film review: watch 3 best attempts — approach angle + arm swing

[3] Power Strength (20 min)
Trap Bar Deadlift explosive intent — phase-dependent
Jump squat light bar or BW 4x5 — explode through floor
Depth drop → jump — phase-dependent off 18-24in box

[4] Rotational Athleticism (12 min)
Rotational med ball throw 10-15lb 4x6 each side
Hip-driven lateral bound 3x5 each side
Single-leg landing → explode 4x5 each leg

[5+6] Shoe Testing + Recovery (15 min)
TRACTION REPORT: shoe test on court — rate traction, lockdown, response
Tibialis raises 3x20 + Soleus raises 3x15
Foam roll + cool down 8 min
LOG SESSION IN DUNK LAB: vertical jump, stage, shoe worn, notes

JUMP SCIENCE FOCUS:
- Penultimate Step max effort: LONG penultimate, hips drop 4-6in
- Ground Contact: film at 60fps, count frames, target <0.20 sec
- Arm Sync: arms must still travel UP at moment feet leave ground

LOG IN APP — Required after every Friday session

Dunk Lab:
- Standing reach (inches)
- Max jump reach (inches)
- Vertical jump (max minus standing)
- Best dunk stage achieved
- Shoe worn + traction rating

Jump Science Ground Contact Tracker:
- Ground contact time (from 60fps film)
- Penultimate step quality 1-5
- Arm swing sync 1-5
- Ankle stiffness felt 1-5

MIDWEEK PERISHABLE REFRESH — 20-30 min
Before court — quick stop only
Store: ALDI or Walmart (closest)

If needed:
- Fresh salmon (Sat/Sun dinner)
- Avocados (buy firm — ripens by Monday)
- Bananas or berries if running low
- Extra eggs or chicken if needed

events.summary: Basketball Skill Day 2 — Shooting + Game Speed
events.description:
75-MIN BASKETBALL SKILL SESSION

[1] Court Warm-Up (8 min)
Full-court layup series 5x each side both hands
Form shooting 5 ft — 20 makes
Dynamic court warm-up — slides, shuffles, back-pedal 3 laps

[2] Catch and Shoot (15 min)
Corner catch + shoot 10x each corner
Wing relocate + shoot 5x each wing — run into catch
Transition 3 run + catch 5x each wing — game speed

[3] Pull-Up Game (15 min)
Elbow pull-up 5x each wing
Step-back 3 from wing 5x each side
Midrange pull-up off 1 dribble 5x each side

[4] Finishing (15 min)
Dunk approach work 10x max reach
Off-two-feet jumper at rim 10x
Power layup game speed 5x each side

[5] Competitive Shooting (12 min)
Spot shooting challenge — see Shooting Lab

[6] Conditioning (10 min)
Full-court sprints 4x, slides, transition finishing

50-MIN SHOOTING SESSION

[1] Corner 3 Machine (12 min)
Right corner 15 attempts → Left corner 15
Right corner off 1-dribble 10 → Left off 1-dribble 10
Feet set BEFORE the catch — stance beats the ball

[2] Off-Dribble: Elbow Pull-Ups + Step-Back (15 min)
Right elbow pull-up 10x 1-2 step footwork
Left elbow pull-up 10x
Right wing step-back 8x — attack hard, step straight back
Left wing step-back 8x

[3] Finishing Tier 2 — Game Changers (10 min)
Euro step 4x8 each direction around cone at charge circle
Running floater 3x10 each side — must go over raised barrier
Contact layup 3x10 with partner resistance

[4] Competitive: Beat the Pro (10 min)
Pro scores 7/10 automatically
You: 5 spots x 2 shots = 10
Must match or beat 7 — track W/L
Win 3 consecutive? Raise pro to 8/10

90-MIN HIGH PERFORMANCE TRAINING

[1] Movement Prep (10 min)
Dynamic warm-up circuit
Hip activation band work
Ankle circles + calf raises 2x15

[2] Mobility (10 min)
Hip mobility flow — world greatest stretch
Ankle mobility
Pigeon pose 60 sec each side

[3] Jump Development (15 min)
Approach jumps to rim 10x max reach
Pogo progressions — fast pogos 2x10 as primer
Single-leg depth drops 3x5 each — control landing

[4] Strength Development (30 min)
Trap Bar Deadlift — phase-dependent
Slant Board Squat — phase-dependent
Slant Board Isometric 5x45 sec LAST
Copenhagen Plank 3x25-35 sec
Single-Leg RDL 3x8-10 each

[5] Athletic Development (12 min)
Linear acceleration runs 5x20m
Pro agility 5-10-5 4x each direction
Lateral defensive slides 3x10m

[6+7] Basketball Transfer + Recovery (13 min)
Approach jumps + arm swing sync test
Foam roll full lower body
Hip flexor stretch

JUMP SCIENCE FOCUS:
- Reactive Activation: fast pogos 2x10 before every plyometric set
- Arm Sync Test: 3 jumps no arm swing vs 3 full swing — feel the difference
- Weekly Vertical Check: mark wall, 3 max jumps, record best, LOG IN DUNK LAB

MEAL PREP — Sets up Mon through Wed on autopilot

Checklist:
- Grill or air-fry 3-4 lbs chicken breast — portion into 6 oz containers
- Cook large batch brown rice 4-6 servings — fridge safe 5 days
- Roast 4-5 sweet potatoes at 400F for 45 min
- Hard-boil 8 eggs for backup protein
- Pre-wash and dry salad greens — store with paper towel to stay crisp
- Measure and bag oat portions for Mon-Wed mornings (50g each)

CONTENT ENGINE — Sunday Review

- Review week's training footage
- Select best 3-5 clips for content
- Script next week's posts
- Post Sunday progress update or weekly review video
- Log weekly analytics in app
- Complete 8-question Sunday review in Traction Report app

Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
Post time target: 7:00-8:00 PM
